# California Gym Cancellation Checklist

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/file-earmark-text.svg

- Confirm the exact **membership start date**, renewal date, and any early-termination language.
- Ask whether the gym accepts **out-of-state relocation** as a cancellation reason.
- Ask what **proof of move** they require, if any, and whether a lease, utility bill, or employer letter is acceptable.
- Confirm the **notice method** they require: email, certified mail, in-person form, or portal submission.
- Ask the **effective cancellation date** under the 30-day written notice rule.
- Ask whether the auto-renewal can be stopped immediately or only after the notice period ends.
- Ask if any **final billing**, prorated charges, or cancellation fees apply.
- Ask for a **written confirmation number** or cancellation confirmation email.
- Keep copies of the signed contract, your notice, and delivery proof.

# Cancellation Letter Draft

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/envelope.svg

Subject: Membership Cancellation Notice

[Your Name]
[Current Mailing Address]
[City, State, ZIP]
[Email Address]
[Phone Number]
[Date]

To Whom It May Concern:

Please accept this letter as written notice that I am requesting cancellation of my gym membership effective in accordance with the contract’s notice requirements.

My membership began on 2026-01-15. I moved out of state on 2026-03-01 and am providing this notice for your records. Please confirm the cancellation date, any remaining balance, and whether any additional documentation is needed.

Please send written confirmation of this cancellation to my email or mailing address listed above.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Membership ID, if available]

# Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Review contract] https://www.dca.ca.gov/
Action: [Button: Send certified mail] https://www.usps.com/ship/letters.htm

- California Department of Consumer Affairs: https://www.dca.ca.gov/
- California Legislative Information: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/
- USPS Certified Mail info: https://www.usps.com/ship/letters.htm
